lines.li: [us] What do you miss most when you're on the road?
[them,them:married,!them:spousehere] {THEIRSPOUSE}, and my own bed, in that order.
[them,them:smallchild,!them:childhere] {THEIRCHILD}, more than I'd ever tell them.
[them] My own bed, and nobody asking me where I'm from.
[us] Then you'll be glad to get home.
[them] Glad to get home, and sorry to leave, both at once.
[us] What frightens you, {OUTSIDER}?
[them,trait:Wimp] Most things, if I'm honest, and I usually am.
[them,trait:Psychopath] Nothing, and I'm told that's the frightening part.
[them,them:parent,!them:childhere] Something happening to {THEIRCHILD} while I'm away.
[them] Losing people, the same as anyone.
[us] That's the one that gets all of us.
[us] What's your favorite thing to eat?
[them,trait:Gourmand] Everything, in large amounts, and I won't apologize for it.
[them,trait:Ascetic] Plain bread and water, and I can see you don't believe me.
[them,their:tribal] Fat from the hunt, roasted on the first night.
[them] Something hot that somebody else cooked.
[us] I know exactly what you mean.
[them] Do you know the one about the trader and the muffalo?
[us] No, go on.
[them] Neither do I, I only ever hear the start of it before someone laughs.
[us] That's a terrible joke.
[them] And yet you're smiling.
[us] Where do you see yourself in a few years?
[them,role:trader] Behind a stall of my own, with my feet up between customers.
[them,them:old] Sitting down, mostly, and telling the young how it used to be.
[them,their:tribal] By the same fire, with more children running around it.
[them] Somewhere with a roof I don't have to fix myself.
[us] I hope you get there.
[them] Ask me next time, and I'll tell you how close I am.
[us] Did you always want to do this, travel and all?
[them,teen] I'm still deciding, ask me in ten years.
[them,old] I wanted a hundred things, and got about six of them.
[them] Some days, and the other days I want a farm.
[us] That sounds like everyone I know.
[them] I feel like I've known you longer than I have.
[us] It's the talking, we do a lot of it.
[them] We do, and I'd like to keep doing it.
[them] We keep ending up talking, you and I.
[us] Is that a complaint?
[them] Not yet.
[them] I've talked more with you than with anyone at home lately.
[us] Then home must be very quiet.
[them] Or you're very easy to talk to.
[us] I'll take that.
[them] I hoped I'd run into you.
[us,trait:Abrasive] Most people hope the opposite.
[us] Here I am, then.
[them] Here you are.
[them] Every road I take seems to end here lately.
[us] I'm glad it does.
[them] So am I, more than I'd say in front of anyone else.
[us] Then say it quietly, just to me.
[them] Then I'm very glad, {COLONIST}.
[them] I've been thinking about you, since last time.
[us] Good thoughts, I hope.
[them] Good enough to make me blush, and I don't blush.
[us] You talk about food like a cook.
[them] I am one, and I've been judging your kitchen since I walked in.
[us,us:best:Cooking] Judge away, I'll take the blame for it.
[us] What's the verdict?
[them] Ask me after supper.
[us] You've a way with animals, I'd guess.
[them] Better than with most people, and they complain less.
[us,colony:animals] Ours might like you, then.
[us] Then you'd fit in out here.
[them] Animals take you as you are, people never do.
[us] You've the hands of a miner.
[them] Stone dust in every crease, it never washes out.
[us] Do you like it, under the ground?
[them] It's quiet, it's cool, and nobody asks me to smile.
[us] You're very easy to talk to, {OUTSIDER}.
[them] It's half my work, talking, and the other half is listening.
[us] Which is harder?
[them] Listening, every time.
[us] You talk like someone who reads a great deal.
[them,their:tribal] I read the sky, the tracks and the old marks on the stones.
[them] Anything I can get my hands on, even the dull ones.
[us] What are you reading now?
[them] You, a little, and you're more interesting than most books.
[them] I make things that don't do anything except look nice.
[us] That's doing something.
[them,their:tribal] The elders say the same, and then ask me to carve a spoon.
[them] Tell that to the people who pay me.
[us] Where did you learn to fight?
[them,their:tribal] On the hunt, and then on worse hunts.
[them,their:empire] In the Empire's service, where they teach it properly.
[them] Here and there, and mostly the hard way.
[us] Is there an easy way?
[them] Not that I ever found.
[them] I keep looking at your roofs, it's a habit.
[us] And?
[them] And I'll keep my opinions until somebody asks for them properly.
[us] Consider this asking.
[them] Then they'll hold, which is more than I can say for most.
[them,trait:Ascetic] You keep a lot of things here, more than anyone needs.
[us] Things have a way of piling up.
[them] I keep one bag and one blanket, and I sleep fine.
[them,trait:NightOwl] This is my favorite hour, with everyone else asleep.
[us] Not everyone.
[them] Then you and I can keep each other company.
[them,trait:TooSmart] I've already worked out three ways you could run this place better.
[us] Go on, then.
[them] Another time, you'd only argue.
[them,trait:Greedy] Everything has a price, you know, even friendship.
[us] And what's ours worth?
[them] More every visit, which is why I keep coming.
[them] Sit down a moment, you look like you've been on your feet all day.
[us] Is it that obvious?
[them] Only to someone who looks.
[them] You talk a lot, don't you?
[us,trait:Abrasive] Not as much as you.
[us] Only to people I like.
[them] Then I'll take it as a compliment, this once.
[us] You took a knock, by the look of you.
[them,trait:Tough] It looks worse than it is, I'm hard to break.
[them] It looks worse than it is, I hope.
[us] Rest a while before you go on.
[them] You're one of the healers here, aren't you?
[us] I patch people up, when they let me.
[them,them:hurt] Then I know who to ask if this gets any worse.
[them] Good, every place needs someone like that.
[them] You've the look of someone who does the fighting here.
[us,trait:Kind] Only when I have to.
[us] Someone has to.
[them] True, and better someone who doesn't enjoy it too much.
[them] Do they always send you to talk to strangers?
[us] Usually, I'm the one who doesn't mind.
[them] Then they chose well.
[them] You've soil under your nails, a grower, I'd say.
[us] Guilty.
[them,them:best:Plants] Then we should talk seed, you and I, before I go.
[them] Then I'll trust whatever's on your table.
[them] Did you have a hand in building this place?
[us] More than a hand, most of both arms.
[them] It shows, in the good way.
[them] You've been around a while yourself, {COLONIST}.
[us] Long enough to know better, and do it anyway.
[them,them:old] The best kind of old, then, the same as me.
[them] The best kind of old, then.
[them] Do you have little ones of your own?
[us] {OURCHILD} is my youngest, and I haven't slept properly since.
[them,them:parent] Nor will you, but it's worth it.
[them] I've heard that's how it goes.
[them] You lost someone too, didn't you?
[us] I did.
[them] It doesn't get smaller, you just grow bigger around it.
[us] That's the truest thing anyone's said to me about it.
[them] You never talk about your family, {COLONIST}.
[us] There was someone, once.
[them] I'm sorry, I didn't mean to pry.
[us] You didn't, it's good to say it out loud sometimes.
[us] What will you tell them at home about us?
[them,likesus] That you're good people, and the food's not bad.
[them,wary] That I haven't made up my mind yet.
[them,!likesus,!wary] That you're still here, which is more than some can say.
[us] That'll do.
[us] Will they be missing you in {TOWN}?
[them,them:married,!them:spousehere] {THEIRSPOUSE} will, and will say so loudly when I'm back.
[them,role:head|role:heir] Everyone will, since the work piles up without me.
[them] A few will, and the rest will notice when the gossip dries up.
[us] Then don't stay away too long.
[us] What's the weather like in {TOWN} just now?
[them,home:cold] Cold, and colder at night, and everyone wrapped up to the eyes.
[them,home:hot] Hot, and everyone moving slowly from one patch of shade to the next.
[them,home:mild] Mild, which is the best anyone can ask.
[us] I'll picture it, next time I'm out in ours.
